name: Exp_ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle_MMRec_Duplex
summary: This EA trades based on the Color Schaff JCCX Trend Cycle indicator, using its trend cycle signals for entry and exit decisions. It employs a money management recovery (MMRec) system with duplex mode, suggesting dual-direction trading capability with position recovery logic after losses. The strategy systematically opens positions when the Schaff trend cycle indicator confirms directional momentum shifts.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Color Schaff JCCX趋势循环指标进行交易，利用其趋势循环信号作为入场和出场决策依据。它采用资金管理恢复（MMRec）系统和双工模式，暗示具备双向交易及亏损后仓位恢复功能。当Schaff趋势循环指标确认方向性动量转变时，该策略系统性地开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Schaff趋势循环指标（JCCX变体），这是一种将随机振荡器与移动平均线结合的趋势循环检测工具。入场条件依赖于趋势循环线的交叉信号：当循环线从超卖区域上穿信号线时做多，从超买区域下穿时做空。出场条件包括趋势循环反向交叉信号触发的平仓，以及可能存在的止损和止盈设置。仓位管理方面，MMRec（资金管理恢复）系统表明该EA在亏损后可能增加仓位大小以尝试恢复资金，这是一种带有马丁格尔倾向的仓位调整方法。双工（Duplex）模式意味着EA可以同时在两个方向上管理交易，或者在主策略和恢复策略之间切换。资金管理结合了固定手数和恢复性递增手数的混合模式，风险敞口随亏损深度而动态调整。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the Schaff Trend Cycle indicator (JCCX variant), which combines stochastic oscillators with moving averages for trend cycle detection. Entry conditions rely on crossover signals from the trend cycle lines: going long when the cycle line crosses above the signal line from oversold territory, and going short when crossing below from overbought territory. Exit conditions include position closing triggered by reverse trend cycle crossover signals, along with possible stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing employs the MMRec (Money Management Recovery) system, indicating the EA may increase position size after losses to attempt capital recovery, which is a position adjustment method with Martingale tendencies. The Duplex mode means the EA can manage trades in both directions simultaneously, or switch between a primary strategy and a recovery strategy. Money management combines a mixed mode of fixed lots and recovery-incremental lots, with risk exposure dynamically adjusting based on the depth of losses.

parameters.name: MMRecovery
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理恢复模式

parameters.name: DuplexMode
parameters.description: 是否启用双工交易模式

pros: Schaff趋势循环指标对趋势转折点较为敏感，能较早捕捉方向变化
双工模式允许同时管理多空方向，增加了策略灵活性
MMRec资金恢复系统在连续亏损后尝试通过仓位调整恢复资金，提供了一种系统化的恢复机制
pros_en: The Schaff Trend Cycle indicator is relatively sensitive to trend turning points, capturing directional changes early
Duplex mode allows simultaneous management of both long and short directions, increasing strategy flexibility
The MMRec capital recovery system provides a systematic recovery mechanism by adjusting position sizes after consecutive losses
cons: MMRec恢复系统本质上具有马丁格尔特征，在持续亏损时可能放大风险敞口
止损和止盈默认为0，若用户未手动设置则交易无保护性出场
Schaff趋势循环指标在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号，导致过度交易和手续费损耗
cons_en: The MMRec recovery system inherently carries Martingale characteristics, potentially amplifying risk exposure during sustained losses
Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, leaving trades without protective exits if users do not manually configure them
The Schaff Trend Cycle indicator tends to generate frequent false signals in choppy markets, leading to overtrading and commission erosion
improvements: 应增加震荡市场过滤器（如ADX或波动率阈值），在无明确趋势时减少交易频率
MMRec系统应设置最大恢复倍数上限和最大连续亏损次数限制，防止风险无限放大
improvements_en: Add a choppy market filter (such as ADX or volatility threshold) to reduce trading frequency when no clear trend exists
The MMRec system should impose a maximum recovery multiplier cap and maximum consecutive loss limit to prevent unlimited risk escalation

risk_points: MMRec资金恢复模式具有马丁格尔性质，亏损后递增仓位可能导致指数级风险增长
默认止损止盈为0，若无手动设置则交易完全依赖指标信号出场，缺乏硬性风险保护
risk_points_en: The MMRec recovery mode has Martingale properties, where incrementally increasing positions after losses can lead to exponential risk growth
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, so without manual configuration trades rely entirely on indicator signals for exit, lacking hard risk protection

summary_en: This EA trades based on the Color Schaff JCCX Trend Cycle indicator, using its trend cycle signals for entry and exit decisions. It employs a money management recovery (MMRec) system with duplex mode, suggesting dual-direction trading capability with position recovery logic after losses. The strategy systematically opens positions when the Schaff trend cycle indicator confirms directional momentum shifts.
